title: Clinical application of software-based CT data analysis for fracture assessment and bone density measurement of the spine.
summary: This retrospective study investigates whether AI-based software can automatically determine spinal bone density from CT data. The aim is to evaluate the diagnostic value for fracture detection and therapy monitoring.

interventions.name: Retrospective data analysis of spinal CT examinations for opportunistic bone density assessment using AI-based software

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients who underwent a CT examination as part of routine clinical care at LMU University Hospital between July 2015 and January 12, 2025
Exclusion criteria:
Patients with insufficient image quality or spinal instrumentation that prevents bone density measurements
